subject: general
question: Find the roots of (6)/(x)-(2)/(x-1)-(1)/(x-2)=0.
solution:
**Given:**

 (6)/(x)-(2)/(x-1)-(1)/(x-2)=0 

**Formula Used:**

LCM method for combining fractions

**Calculation:**

 {LCM of } x, x-1, { and } x-2 { is } x(x-1)(x-2) 

⇒ (6(x-1)(x-2) - 2x(x-2) - x(x-1))/(x(x-1)(x-2))=0 

⇒ 6(x²-3x+2)-2x(x-2)-x(x-1)=0 

⇒ 6x²-18x+12-2x²+4x-x²+x=0 

⇒ 3x²-13x+12=0 

Using quadratic formula ax²+bx+c=0 

 x=frac{-bpmsqrt{b²-4ac}}{2a} 

 a=3, b=-13, c=12 

⇒ x=frac{13pmsqrt{169-144}}{6} 

⇒ x=(13±5)/(6) 

⇒ x=(18)/(6)=3, {or} x=(8)/(6)=(4)/(3) 

**The roots are ( x = 3 ) and ( x = 4/3).**
